thread:
anya: quick flag — compact console table: action icons overlap clickable row area on hover. I mis-tapped trash and opened the row :grimacing:
rafa: can repro on mac/chrome. looks like compact spacing + negative margin on .row-actions.
sam: avoid changing spacing tokens globally. options: increase button internal hitbox, add invisible touch target, or make the row click ignore events when pointer is over actions.
anya: prefer expanding internal hitbox so visuals stay tight. also need keyboard focus to work.
rafa: prototype CSS: .action-btn { padding: 8px; margin: -2px; } and ensure .row { pointer-events: auto; } with .action-strip { pointer-events: auto; } only on hover/focus. watch keyboard tab order.
sam: accessibility: ensure min 44px touch target for mobile, and add aria-labels to actions ("Delete model", not just "Delete"). toasts: current "Saved" is ambiguous; include subject e.g. "Model saved" and include aria-live semantics.
anya: sam — can you draft toast copy variants for model, policy, deployment flows? I'll test the prototype on iPhone simulator.
aria-bot: suggested toast patterns: ["Model saved", "Policy published", "Deployment queued"], use aria-live="polite" for success, assertive for errors. include visually hidden context when needed.
raf a: action items: sam to create copy list + aria labels; rafa to ship CSS prototype; anya to validate mobile.
